content: Jesu ning alang kithipa amindam
Nikho alek soa Jesu ning Capernaum teng aleikirnok, khan inna khan ama aom jei ti chong alei kinthang.
Khawa jarra mi katamtak anheiwa a khawakhan tungnasik mun korok leiommak, inkhar ma kutunga amun leirok mak. Jesu ning Pathien chongkha anmanideng aleiril lai
pasal minli ngaining, alang kithipa inkhat Jesu deng anhei kadomma anhongpha.
Mipui antam hei jarra, mipa kha ama kolla heilutpui tormuk. Khawa jarra anmani ning Jesu omna inchung khan anmin wenga mipa kha ajalna pher le kinroi a anhei makhai minchum.
Anmani ngaikha kha-angtuk taksenna kha alei mukar, Jesu ning alang kithi mipa deng aleiti, <<Kasapa, nisetna ngaikha kanarangai mindam sojei.>>
Khawa khan alei kin ong Dan oja alekning anbinga anleimindon,
<<Kho-ongmo amaning hi-anghin achong tor e? Hiwa hichu Pathien chunga arildek e! Pathien amabei e setna karangai mindam torchu!>>
Khawa laitak a Jesu ning anmani mulung mindon kha ajet a, anmanideng aleiti,

content.text: Alang kithi mipa deng, <Nisetna ngai kanarangai mindam pejei,> ti a-imakli, <Kinding inlang, napher kodom inlang, khan lonro, ti himo abeidet?>
Keining nangni deng niril minchenpe kate, Miring Sapa ning leithoichunga setna rangai mindam sik ranak anei.>>

content: khawa jarra amaning alang kithipa deng aleiti,

content.text: <<Keining nangdeng kiti, theiro, napher lei inlang, khan ni-inna setro!>>

content: Anmani ning an-inna an-omlai, mi pakha atheili, apher kha akadomma kinnot a mipui maikunga aleisuok. Anmani rikip ning anleingak a Pathien anleiminpak, <<Eini ning hiwa anghi lumungai phitmakmi!>> anleiti.
Jesu ning Levi akoi
Jesu ning woikhat Galilee tuitham pangteng ahong kirnok a. Mipui katamtak amadeng anheiwa, khan amaning anmani kha minchuna aleiphut jei.
Ama kha-ang khan asena, amaning ramsel karathai, Alphaeus sapa Levi ramsel telna inna aleikin ong kha aleimu. Jesu ning amadeng, <<Nujuiro,>> aleiti. Levi ning akinding a anuk aleijui.
Khawa soa Jesu ning Levi inna bu aleibak.
Ramsel karathai katamtak ngaile setkoron ngaining Jesu nuk anleijui, khanna anmani katamtak ning amale athiemroi ngaikha bu anlei bakbung.
Dan Oja alek, Pharisees num aki e, Jesu ning ramsel karathai le setkoron ngaile bu anbak bungkha anleimu, khawa jarra ama thiemroi ngaideng anleirakal, <<Angsikmi amaning hiwa mi ngaile abakpui hi?>>

Jesu ning hiwa ajet a anmanideng aleimasang, <<Akadam ngaisik chu thiempu rangaimak, takkha akana ngaisik bei arangai. Keining kahong hichu mikidik ngai akakoi kahong imong, takkha setkoron ngai akakoi kahong e.>>
Bungei jarra chongrakal

Rei inkhat a John Baptist anuk kujui ngai le Pharisees ngai ning bu anleingei. Mi alek ning Jesu deng anhonga anleirakal, <<John Baptist thiemroi ngaile Pharisees thiemroi ngaining bu an-ngei a, khan nang thiemroi ngaining angsik mi bu an-ngeimak e?>>
Jesu ning aleimasang, <<Moiroina akahong khomol ngaikha bu baklei ankir sik ninti mi? Kha imak! Moipa ning anmanile aomlai sengchu, anmani ning kha-ang thononung.
Takkha moipa kha anmanideng ria anroi sik nikho alahongsik e, khawa karkhan anmani bu anlangei sik e.>>
<<Atu inkhat ningnum pon kather awerkhat kha pon maro a kuthui delmuk, ajarchu pon kather awerkhat khaning pon maro kha akeirinna, akolok det a akinther sik.

Khanok chu atute ningnum sawun juhai muro a juther dangaimak, ajarchu ju khaning sawun juhai aminkoi sik, khan ju le sawun juhaikha akinmang sikjei. Khawa nek a, juther kha sawun juhaither a thunsik e.>>
Jehudi serni jarra rakalna
Jesu ning Jehudi Serni kini khan sang billa aleise. Ama thiemroi ngai ning amale anheiwalai, anmani ning sawui kha anlei richil.
Khawa jarra Pharisees ngaining Jesu deng anleiti, <<Enro, nang thiemroi ngai ning eini Dan le akintok mak Jehudi Serni ning antho hi!>>
Jesu ning aleimasang, <<Nangni paalei mo nin e David ning angmo aleitho baksik inkhat amanompha? Ama le ami ngaining anwon acham karra,

amaning Pathien inn alut a khan Pathien denga anpe waipol kha aleibak. Hiwahi Abiathar ning Thiempu Chungnung achang laikhan aleisuok. Eini Senadan dungjui a hiwa waipol hichu thiempu beining anbak sik e tak David ning num aleibak, khan ama mi ngainum aleipe.>>
Khan Jesu ning atorna ati, <<Jehudi Serni kini hichu miring ngai thanasik a anbol e; miring ngaihi Jehudi Serning kini sik a abol imak.
Khawa jarra Miring Sapa hi Jehudi Serni kini ning sik num Puma e.>>

footnotes.text: : Levi inna; a-imakli ama (khawa kha, Jesu e) inn.
